COMMAND_REVIVE: Revive and heal (yourself or a player)
COMMAND_CAR: Spawn a vehicle and sit in it
COMMAND_DV: Delete the vehicle you sit in or stand next to
COMMAND_COORDS: Show your position (also printed in F8)
COMMAND_P_COORDS: x y z, x, y, z or x y (onto the ground)
NOTIFY_BROUGHT: An admin brought you to them.
ERR_NOT_ALLOWED: You do not have permission for this.
ERR_NO_WAYPOINT: Set a waypoint on the map first.
ERR_PLAYER_ONLY: Only a player in the game can do this.
ERR_NO_WEATHER: No weather script runs (or it refused the value).
COMMAND_P_WEATHER: EXTRASUNNY, CLEAR, CLOUDS, RAIN, THUNDER, SNOW, XMAS...
COMMAND_BLACKOUT: Turn the city lights off (1) or on (0)
COMMAND_FREEZETIME: Stop the clock (1) or let it run (0)
ERR_DOWN: That player is down: use revive.
ERR_MODEL: No vehicle with that model name.
ERR_VEHICLE: The vehicle could not be created.
ERR_NO_VEHICLE: No vehicle in or next to you.
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: How noclip moves and how announcements look. The menu (F9) and noclip keys are set in ai-core's Keybinds tab.
ADMIN_C_NOCLIP_DESC: Speed levels while flying: the mouse wheel changes the level, a wheel click resets it, Shift, Alt and Ctrl multiply it while held.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_SPEED: Speed level when noclip starts and after a wheel click.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_MAX: The mouse wheel stops at this level.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_STEP: Level change per mouse wheel notch; also the lowest level.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_FAST: Speed multiplier while Shift is held.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_FASTER: Speed multiplier while Alt is held.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_SLOW: Speed multiplier while Ctrl is held (below 1 slows down).
ADMIN_C_ANNOUNCE_DESC: The notification every player sees for /announce.
ADMIN_H_ANNOUNCE_KIND: Colour and icon of the notification.
ADMIN_C_CAR_DESC: What a vehicle spawned with /car or the admin menu comes with. The admin always sits in the driver seat with the keys.
ADMIN_H_CAR_MAXED: Engine, brakes, transmission, suspension and armour at their top level, turbo and xenons on.
ADMIN_H_CAR_ENGINE: The engine is already on when the admin sits in.
ERR_ITEM_FULL: It does not fit in that inventory
ERR_ITEM_NONE: The player has none of that item
ERR_INVENTORY: The inventory could not be opened
COMMAND_ITEMS: Open the item list and take items
COMMAND_GIVEKEY: Give the keys of the vehicle you sit in or stand next to
COMMAND_REMOVEITEM: Take an item from a player (no count: all of it)
